_comment: Original trigger: AutoSys job JOB_CUSTOMER_CDC (every 4 hours)
Step 3 (apply_customer_changes.mp)   -> embedded in cdc_processor notebook (MERGE INTO)
The four-step KSH pipeline collapses to a single notebook because Delta Lake
MERGE handles snapshot-compare-apply atomically. The audit step is a separate
task for isolation and retry independence.
PSET parameters from psets/pset_templates/customer_cdc.pset are mapped
name: customer_cdc_pipeline
description: Customer CDC pipeline running every 4 hours: snapshot -> detect changes -> apply -> audit. Migrated from run_customer_cdc.ksh (AutoSys JOB_CUSTOMER_CDC).

parameters.name: source_path
parameters.description: Source data path. Mapped from PSET SOURCE_PATH.

parameters.name: target_table
parameters.description: Target Delta table. Mapped from PSET TARGET_TABLE (STAGING.CUSTOMER_MASTER).

parameters.name: key_columns
parameters.description: Primary key columns. Mapped from PSET KEY_COLUMNS.

parameters.name: hash_columns
parameters.description: Columns for change detection hash. Mapped from PSET HASH_COLUMNS.

parameters.name: partition_count
parameters.description: Number of Spark partitions. Mapped from PSET PARTITION_COUNT.

parameters.name: batch_size
parameters.description: Records per micro-batch. Mapped from PSET BATCH_SIZE.

parameters.name: max_errors
parameters.description: Error threshold before abort. Mapped from PSET MAX_ERRORS.

parameters.name: audit_table
parameters.description: Audit log table. Mapped from PSET AUDIT_TABLE.

parameters.name: retention_days
parameters.description: Delta Lake retention period in days. Mapped from PSET RETENTION_DAYS.

tasks.description: Execute CDC: snapshot source, MERGE into target, generate audit trail. Replaces all 4 KSH steps (snapshot, detect, apply, audit).
